cookies.description: We use cookies to enhance your experience on our website. By continuing to browse, you agree to our use of cookies.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At MEGA PARKING, located at 4 Mavromichali Street, Piraeus, Greece, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.

collection.title: 1. What Information We Collect
content: Personal data (name, email, phone number, vehicle registration)
Booking and payment information
IP address and browser/device info

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
content: To manage reservations and provide services
To contact you regarding your booking
For customer support and service improvement
To comply with legal obligations

sharing.title: 3. Sharing of Data
content: We do not sell or rent your personal data.
Data may be shared with trusted third parties (e.g., payment processors) only when necessary.

security.title: 4. Data Security
content: We use secure technologies and protocols (e.g., SSL) to protect your personal data.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data.
Contact us at info@megaparking.gr for any requests.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
content: Our website uses cookies to enhance user experience.
You can manage cookies via browser settings.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: By accessing and using www.megaparking.gr, you agree to the following Terms of Service provided by MEGA PARKING, located at 4 Mavromichali Street, Piraeus, Greece.

usage.title: 1. Use of Services
content: Our services include online reservations and parking information.
You agree to provide accurate data and not misuse the platform.

booking.title: 2. Bookings & Payments
content: All bookings are subject to availability.
Payment is due as specified in the confirmation.

cancellations.title: 3. Cancellations
content: Cancellation policies are shown during booking.
Please contact support for any disputes.

liability.title: 4. Limitation of Liability
content: MEGA PARKING is not liable for indirect damages.
Liability is limited to the amount paid for the booking.

ip.title: 5. Intellectual Property
content: All content belongs to MEGA PARKING. Reuse without permission is prohibited.

law.title: 6. Governing Law
content: Terms are governed by Greek law. Disputes will be settled in the courts of Piraeus.
